subject.callable: direct Triton float16 causal packed variable-length GQA attention
subject.boundary: one launch of twenty programs writes the complete 5x4x16 public output

tasks.task_statement: Compute complete float16 packed causal GQA attention for q lengths [2,3], k/v lengths [4,3], explicit scale 0.25 and no optional features.

input_map.basis: tokens 0..1 and 2..4 form the two packed query sequences
tokens 0..3 and 4..6 form the two packed key/value sequences
the maximum represented query length is 3
the maximum represented key/value length is 4
the kernel multiplies each QK score by exact binary 0.25
the kernel applies bottom-right causal masking within each sequence
the kernel has no local window
the kernel has no score softcap
the kernel has no ALiBi score term
the contract observes forward only and the kernel has no backward selector
the kernel returns only the complete attention output
K and V are contiguous packed tensors rather than paged caches
q, k, v and out are contiguous float16 tensors
